decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w3' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9859. Series context: trend strength 0.8356 and seasonal strength 0.1333; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.29); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.855.
